source_prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at twilight with snow-capped mountains and a winding river valley leading to a distant castle. In the foreground a bald pale woman stands beside a solid black devil figure with glowing pink eyes; a small traveler in a red cloak stands on the devil's shoulder. A large vibrant orange serpent with intricate patterns forms an infinity loop around the woman. In the starry cosmic sky an astronaut in a blue suit floats casually smoking a pipe surrounded by galaxies, swirling symbols and a crescent moon. A wooden sign in the corner reads 'THE END'.
